subject: Redwood onboarding: console + API walkthrough — scheduling request
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@spectrumhealth.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Onboarding Ops <onboarding@spectrumhealth.io>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood onboarding: console + API walkthrough — scheduling request

Hi Karthik / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the leadership team at Spectrum liked what we saw and we
are ready to get the technical onboarding started. We need a combined console walkthrough and API
enablement session for our platform engineers and SREs.

Goals:
- Console tour (roles, token management, observability hooks)
- API keys, sample calls, and a short hands-on lab hitting the staging cluster
- Runbook and rollback discussion for early integration

Attendees (approx): 6 people from platform & SRE (list attached in a follow-up). Preferred time window:
- Week of April 3rd, mornings (US Eastern) ideally 9:00–11:30am.

We can be flexible but would prefer mornings because of a downstream maintenance window later that
week. Can you propose 2 slots and any pre-work we should do? Also let us know what credentials or
access you need to prepare the staging environment.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Director, Platform Integrations
Spectrum Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@spectrumhealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 14:06:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding: console + API walkthrough — scheduling request

Samira — really glad to hear the leadership thumbs-up. I can own the kickoff and coordinate enablement.
Quick note: I want to confirm availability with our enablement lead before locking a time. Tentative
options for the week of Apr 3 that we'll try to hold open:
- Tue Apr 4, 09:30–11:00 ET
- Thu Apr 6, 09:00–10:30 ET

Marissa (cc'd) — can you confirm capacity for a 90-minute combined console + API walkthrough in that
window? We expect a short hands-on lab so please reserve a staging slot and the ephemeral service
accounts. Also include any pre-reads or a minimal runbook we want the customer to review.

Samira — we'll follow up with a calendar invite and the pre-work checklist once Marissa confirms.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — confirmed, we can run a 90-minute combined session. Prefer Tue Apr 4 09:30–11:00 ET
(works best for lab engineers). I've provisioned a staging slot and created ephemeral service accounts
for the hands-on portion.

Pre-work for Spectrum (short):
- Read: Redwood onboarding runbook (attached, "redwood_onboard_runbook_v3.pdf")
- Confirm 1 point-of-contact and provide a list of participants and their basic roles
- Ensure their network allows outbound to our staging cluster IP range (see runbook appendix)

Attachments: redwood_onboard_runbook_v3.pdf (runbook), staging-credentials-placeholder.txt (we will
share real creds in the calendar invite as secure notes). I'll create the calendar invite and attach an
.ics.

Ben — can you confirm licensing seats in the deal record (DEAL-8792) so we can include the correct
invite recipients?

Marissa Cole
Enablement Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik / Marissa — Tue Apr 4 09:30–11:00 ET works for us but one small ask: can we move everything 30
minutes earlier to 09:00–10:30 ET? Our SRE lead has a standing conflict that popped up this morning.

If that works on your side please send the updated .ics invite and we'll confirm the final attendee
list. We'll also pull the pre-reads and send a short list of participant names by Monday EOD.

Confirmed attachments to expect from Redwood: redwood_onboard_runbook_v3.pdf, staging-credentials-
placeholder.txt, redwood_console_api_invite.ics

Appreciate it — Samira
Director, Platform Integrations
Spectrum Health
